questions.stem: What is a Data Abstraction Layer (DAL)?
options: A physical storage device that holds all application data
A reporting tool that summarises data for managers
A network layer that routes data between servers
A layer of code that keeps the tricky details of how data is stored or used separate from the rest of the software
A backup process that copies data to a second site
questions.explanation: A Data Abstraction Layer is a layer of code that keeps the complicated details of how data is stored or used separate from the rest of the software.

questions.stem: In a Data Abstraction Layer, what does Abstraction mean?
options: Removing data that is no longer needed
Hiding the complicated details of storing data behind a simpler way of working with it
Compressing data to reduce its size
Encrypting data so it cannot be read
Summarising data into charts
questions.explanation: Abstraction means hiding all the complicated details of storing data behind a simpler way of working with it, so developers need not worry about the nitty-gritty.

questions.stem: How does a Data Abstraction Layer support Separation of Concerns?
options: By storing each department's data in a separate database
By assigning a different developer to each table
By splitting the software into front-end and back-end teams
By encrypting data separately from the application
By separating how data is stored from how the software works, making the software easier to understand and look after
questions.explanation: The Data Abstraction Layer keeps things organised by separating how data is stored from how the software works, making it easier to understand and maintain.

questions.stem: What does the Consistent Interface of a Data Abstraction Layer provide?
options: A set of clear rules the rest of the software follows to work with the data, so it keeps running smoothly even if storage changes
A single user screen for viewing all data
A guarantee that data is never modified
A common colour scheme across applications
A fixed hardware configuration for the database
questions.explanation: The layer provides a set of clear rules that the rest of the software follows to work with the data, which keeps the software running smoothly even when the way data is stored changes.

questions.stem: How does the Adaptability of a Data Abstraction Layer help when the way data is stored changes?
options: The whole application must be rewritten
The data must be migrated back to the old format
Only the Data Abstraction Layer needs to be adjusted and the rest of the software can stay the same
The change is blocked until every module is updated
The application switches to read-only mode
questions.explanation: The Data Abstraction Layer acts like a shield: if storage changes, only the layer itself needs adjusting while the rest of the software stays the same.

questions.stem: What does a Data Abstraction Layer do in terms of Security and Validation?
options: It issues passwords to users
It makes sure data is handled in a safe and controlled way
It scans the network for intruders
It backs up data every hour
It anonymises all personal data automatically
questions.explanation: The Data Abstraction Layer also looks out for the security of the data, making sure it is handled in a safe and controlled way.

questions.stem: Using what can a Data Abstraction Layer be built in real life?
options: Spreadsheets and macros
Tape drives and object storage
Firewalls and routers
APIs or special frameworks
Printed documentation
questions.explanation: In real life, a Data Abstraction Layer can be made using things like APIs or special frameworks.

questions.stem: How are APIs described in the context of a Data Abstraction Layer?
options: A set of rules for talking to a system
A place where data is physically stored
A type of database index
A tool for drawing diagrams
A licence for using software
questions.explanation: APIs are described as a set of rules for talking to a system.

questions.stem: How do frameworks help developers in the context of a Data Abstraction Layer?
options: They automatically write all the application code
They replace the need for a database
They enforce a single programming language
They provide free cloud storage
They let developers work with objects in the software without worrying too much about the underlying details
questions.explanation: Frameworks help developers work with objects, such as pieces of information, in the software without worrying too much about the underlying details.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT one of the listed characteristics of a Data Abstraction Layer?
options: Abstraction
Adaptability
Compression
Separation of Concerns
Consistent Interface
questions.explanation: The listed characteristics are Abstraction, Separation of Concerns, Consistent Interface, Adaptability, and Security and Validation; Compression is not among them.
